description: Main application entry point and home screen structure
reason: Fundamentally different app initialization, routing setup, and root navigation structure between web and native platforms.

description: Primary navigation container and routing structure
reason: Web uses sidebar navigation with react-router, native uses stack/tab navigation with react-navigation. Different navigation paradigms require separate implementations.

description: Home/landing screen with platform-specific layout patterns
reason: Desktop layout uses multi-column sidebar approach, mobile uses full-screen vertical stack. Fundamentally different responsive design patterns.

description: Video reels viewing experience with platform-specific gestures
reason: Desktop uses mouse/keyboard navigation with hover states, mobile uses swipe gestures and touch interactions. Different media playback and interaction models.

description: Search results page layout with map/list toggle
reason: Web supports side-by-side map and list view, native uses full-screen toggle between map and list. Different viewport handling and layout constraints.

description: Full-screen messaging layout with platform-specific navigation
reason: Full-screen messaging layout with platform-specific navigation. Native uses RN stack navigation and full-screen presentation.

description: Agent messaging inbox list before a client conversation is selected

description: Client messaging empty state when no agent is connected
